name: DAMA/LXe
summary: DAMA/LXe was a historical low-background liquid-xenon detector in the DAMA programme, using different isotopically enriched xenon targets to study elastic/inelastic dark-matter scattering and other rare processes.
detection_principle: Liquid-xenon scintillation energy and pulse shape constrain nuclear recoils and de-excitation signals from excited nuclei. This is a different detector from DAMA's NaI annual-modulation apparatus.

key_parameters.value: Krypton-depleted xenon, with possible enrichment in 129Xe or 136Xe

results.summary: Constraints on elastic and inelastic DM–129Xe scattering were reported.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
